definitions.ask: Should a bare ':' (no query letters typed yet) already open the menu?
definitions.why: Bryan asked for ':' itself to trigger the menu; recents make the bare menu useful

choices.label: Opens on the ':' keystroke with recents and popular emoji; Enter right after ':' picks the top row
Waits for the first query character; a bare ':' stays inert and Enter still makes a newline

definitions.ask: Should typing a full ':name:' shortcode auto-replace it with the emoji without a menu selection?
definitions.why: Never rewriting text the user did not select keeps a plain-text vault predictable

choices.label: The closing ':' of an exact shortcode inserts the emoji at once; may rewrite wanted literal text
The closing ':' only dismisses the menu; emoji are inserted solely by selecting a row

definitions.ask: After deploy, should the agent enable the plugin by adding bob-emoji to community-plugins.json?
definitions.why: community-plugins.json is already git-tracked in the vault; one reload makes the feature live

choices.label: Appends the id to the git-tracked vault file, so enablement syncs to every host; live after reload
Leaves enablement to Bryan via Settings -> Community plugins on one host
